sources.excerpt: For LANTERN, I propose a two-week demonstration pilot of the fictional Northstar Loom intake desk.
Please revise the MAPLE onboarding checklist for the fictional intake desk. This is a separate deliverable from the LANTERN pilot.
Continuing the LANTERN pilot from the Pilot idea thread: the two-week demonstration pilot is approved.
The QUARTZ handoff guide has been published to our fictional desk manual.

The MAPLE checklist is needed before LANTERN can launch.
LANTERN still has no launch confirmation.
Please send the revised checklist draft for review.
I have not independently checked the published manual or its contents.
Please prepare the CINDER visitor guide using a similar layout to the handoff guide. I am not sure whether these belong to the same work request.
